runs.before_state:
// Package audit leaves room for normalization rules owned by the delivery boundary.
package audit

observed: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat agents.override.md docs/audit-sinks.md audit/normalize.go audit/event.go audit/sink.go audit/summary.go service/dispatch.go go.mod; cat service/dispatch_test.go audit/event_test.go audit/summary_test.go'

/bin/zsh -lc 'go version
 go env goroot gotooldir gocache
 printenv goversion gotoolchain goroot gotooldir
 ls -a'

/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w audit/normalize.go audit/summary.go service/dispatch.go
 go test ./...
 git diff --check
 git diff --stat
 git diff -- audit/normalize.go audit/summary.go service/dispatch.go'
